title: SCIS MITM · AES-MP collision

target.description: One-block full 128-bit collision in seven-round AES-MP, under a predetermined 128-bit IV/public AES key; no IV freedom.

setting.key_relation: The source-defined public key or public round keys.
setting.plaintext_model: Two distinct 128-bit message blocks; one fixed shared IV.

time.note: Section5 author-model expected work, including SCIS neutral-word generation.

data.note: No secret-key oracle data; message candidates are generated offline.

memory.note: Tdp stores candidates indexed by full compression output; source does not specify entry width.

preprocessing.note: Setup is included in total work unless separately stated.

success.description: The source expects one collision after about 2^60 partial-target candidates; no fixed-budget whole-collision probability is stated. The experiment verifies partial-target generation, not the complete 2^60 collision search.

review.scope: PDF pp.16–19 Eq4, Algorithm2 and partial-target experiment.

evidence.locator: PDF p.7 Table1; pp.9,11 construction and fixed-IV definition; pp.15–19 Section4.5/Section5.
evidence.interpretation: Defining primary-text costs, output event and conditions checked together.

limitations: The complete named output probability is not quantified by the source.

variables.name: h
variables.condition: Predetermined initial value; no IV search is allowed.

variables.name: m
variables.condition: Two distinct message values under the same chaining value.

experiment.distinctness: m != m_prime; the same h is reused for both evaluations.
experiment.reference: Ideal 128-bit compression output, birthday work approximately 2^64.
